text:
Jules: Heads up finance 10: I paid for a full-day coworking pass at WorkHub (day rate €95) on my personal card because the Redwood corp card declined at checkout. Also bought coffee and a desk lamp from the cafe for €12 on the same receipt. I didn't get a VAT invoice, only a merchant receipt. Can I expense to client ENG-CONF (cost center CC-310)? cc @Kai for approval.

Expense-bot: Jules 10: Policy: for VAT reclaim we need a supplier VAT invoice with vendor tax number for amounts with VAT. Missing VAT invoice may block reclaim; you can still be reimbursed net amount but VAT can't be reclaimed without correct docs. For missing vendor invoice > $75 (or equivalent) submit Lost Receipt Form: https://redwood.finance/expenses/lost-receipt.

Jules: I have the merchant receipt photo and a confirmation email from WorkHub reservation. No separate VAT invoice was issued at checkout. Uploaded both to Concur under "Missing VAT invoice". TEMP LINK: https://imgur.com/workhub-reserve. Expense submitted EXP-5307.

Kai: Approved to charge CC-310 for the coworking day and incidentals. Kai: approved 2026-04-04. Please split the line items in Concur: WorkHub daypass €95 as "Workspace" and cafe items €12 as "Meals/Incidental". Include "Client visit: ENG Q2 on-site" in the manager note.

Expense-bot: EXP-5307 received. Note: Finance can reimburse the employee for the gross amount but VAT reclaim requires vendor invoice with VAT ID. If you can request a VAT invoice from WorkHub (email receipts@workhub.eu) and attach it within 30 days, we can process VAT reclaim. Otherwise VAT will be treated as non-recoverable.

Jules: OK I'll email receipts@workhub.eu asking for a VAT invoice and forward any response to finance@redwood. I redacted my card number from the uploaded photo.

Maya: Finance ops here 10: we see EXP-5307. Approving reimbursement pending vendor invoice. If WorkHub provides VAT invoice within 30 days we'll re-open for reclaim. For now marking EXP-5307 Approved for payment net of any required conversions.

Jules: Thanks 10: one more Q: the cafe charge included a small desk lamp sold for €10 that might be considered equipment. Should I classify that as capital or expense?

Kai: Small desk items under €100 are expensed. Put lamp under "Office supplies" and include serial or description. If we want it inventoried we can tag later.

Expense-bot: Payment scheduled for EXP-5307. Allow up to 72 hours to post. Reminder: to avoid corp card declines at merchant terminals, open a cards ticket to cards@redwood and include merchant MCC and merchant name so we can whitelist.

Jules: Sent email to WorkHub receipts and opened a cards ticket with merchant details. Will update thread if VAT invoice arrives. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
